MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The test leads and heat shrink tubing fit my breadboards, wired battery holder, PCB parts, and relay module: they help me test connections and insulate the wiring afterward.",
    "A digital caliper makes sense for measuring small boards and components so I can fit an electronics assembly together. I would choose the NEIKO caliper for that purpose."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The printer filaments assume a 3D printing project that my history does not establish. Working with electronics does not give me a current need for PLA or ABS, much less a particular filament color.",
    "The locking nuts and diamond burrs need a specific fastening or shaping task to be useful to me, and I have no such task right now.",
    "The other calipers serve a relevant purpose, but choosing one already meets my measuring need; I would not buy several similar tools."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in hands-on electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in supplies for almost any making or workshop activity.",
    "Recognizing that a measuring tool could help me seems to have led to assuming that several versions would each be useful purchases."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The clearest connection across my electronics purchases is wiring, prototyping, and testing small circuits. Accessories that directly support those tasks are especially useful to me.",
    "I choose items when they solve a concrete project need. A tool or material being broadly related to DIY is not enough to make me want it now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my electronics tinkering, but stretched that interest into unrelated workshop supplies and repeated a measuring need that one caliper would satisfy."
}
